# Pricing fixtures

`openai-pricing.md` and `anthropic-pricing.md` contain pricing-table excerpts fetched on 2026-11-04 from the official Markdown sources:

- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing.md
- https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing.md

Whitespace is compacted. The final out-of-scope tables include synthetic sentinel models to test section boundaries. These are regression inputs, not a current pricing catalog.
